title: Wildfires: How can you stay safe and protect the countryside?

content.text: This summer has brought some of our hottest days on record, increasing the risk of wildfires.

Most wildfires in the UK are caused by human activity – from littering to leaving a campfire unattended. One small spark can quickly spread into a blaze that threatens the countryside, habitats, homes, and infrastructure, particularly during warm, dry weather.
